about_the_game:
Welcome to Havenstead — a cozy town-builder where strategy and charm go hand-in-hand. Build a thriving village, gather resources, trade with travelers, and balance the needs of your villagers as your settlement grows! 

Main Features:

  • Strategic, yet Approachable – Dive into the charming town-building vibe, while still balancing supply, demand, and long-term planning with intuitive mechanics that do not require constant micro-management. 

  • Grid-Based Building System - Smooth building placement & removal with a dedicated grid system. 

  • Cozy & Immersive – Watch everything come alive throughout the town. Take a moment to watch the Fields growing during Spring, Cows grazing at your Cattle Ranches, a Villager chopping down a Tree - or better yet, enjoying an Ale! 

  • Villagers Automatically Perform Their Tasks - Manage your Villagers with the Job Board, and keep track of everything in your Town with in-game overlays. 

  • Happiness Rating System – A dynamic “happiness” score influenced by population size, available supplies, town wealth, commodities like ale, and luxury items.

  • Trade & Unique Items – Traveling traders will visit your town periodically for limited amounts of time. You can trade goods and purchase rare items such as chests with random rewards, rare scrolls unlocking special blueprints, and artifacts like chalices or statues that provide permanent buffs.

What Else Is Coming Before Release? - Plans for Havenstead Include The Following:

  • Various Maps / Scenarios

  • Town Levels & Tech Tree

  • Expanded Trade Functions & Diplomacy Benefits

  • Additional Buildings, Resources, Commodity Items, and Villager Jobs

  • Improved Artwork, Environments, Audio, UI, and Assets for Building Models, Props, and Character Animations 

  • Save System, Difficulty Settings, and more!...

Please Note: Havenstead is under solo development.  Public Demo is planned for early 2026, with full release timeline following based on feedback & scaling requirements following that.  If you are interested in private playtesting now & through the development process, please join the Discord.  Thank you!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: iOS 15.0 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal API supported
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
